trust_decision.summary: A config file that lives inside the opened workspace may name an arbitrary command/env; the decision to execute it must be an explicit, per-(server, full execution config, workspace) user approval persisted outside the workspace, and the gate must sit below every start route (initOneServerInternal) rather than in the mcp.json parser.

landing_point.why: The report says a repo's .amazonq/mcp.json starts a command, so the first read is loadMcpServerConfigs, which parses that file and stamps __configPath__ (mcpUtils.ts:134); the prompt would naturally be put there.

hasApproval/recordApproval called from the gate (fix.diff:487, fix.diff:527)

O3_reason_to_dismiss: An approval is already scoped to (server name, workspace), and the registry pins the command, so re-prompting when only the env override changes is unnecessary churn.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Global, user-authored configs under ~/.aws/amazonq (mcp.json, agents/default.json, personas/default.json) must keep starting with no prompt, and an already-approved workspace server must not re-prompt on every reload; upstream's own second commit weakened the fingerprint match to an OR with workspaceHash precisely to stop that re-prompting (fix.diff:624-630), which reopens the hole the fingerprint exists for.

O7_producer.where: server/aws-lsp-codewhisperer/src/language-server/agenticChat/tools/mcp/mcpUtils.ts:473-487 (registry cfg plus __additionalEnv__/__additionalHeaders__) and mcpManager.ts:429-436 (runtime env merge); the gate reads cfg.__configPath__ and fingerprints cfg but never calls either producer

O8_uncovered_routes.route: Env of a registry-type server comes from the workspace agent/mcp config entry and is merged into the child process env at spawn, but it is stored as __additionalEnv__ and never fingerprinted, so it can change after approval without a new prompt
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: Only applies to registry servers, whose command and args are pinned by the registry, so an env tweak looks like a benign user setting rather than a change of what executes.
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: one file (mcpUtils.ts) and one package from the gate in mcpManager.ts

O8_uncovered_routes.route: Workspace-scoped agent config files (.amazonq/agents/*.json) carry their own mcpServers and reach the same spawn; the published diff never touches this loader, so a gate keyed on the report's file name (.amazonq/mcp.json) leaves it open
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: These are the user's own UI-managed agent settings, not the repo's MCP config the report names, and the existing code already treats only 'mcp.json' as the legacy MCP file (mcpManager.ts:1077).
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: same directory, different file from the gate

O8_uncovered_routes.route: Additional headers for remote (HTTP/SSE) servers are attached from the workspace config entry but are not part of the approval fingerprint
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: Headers cannot execute code, so they look irrelevant to an approval about running a command.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: A fourth __-prefixed overlay (e.g. __additionalArgs__ or __additionalCwd__ sourced from the workspace config entry) that is merged at spawn but not covered by the approval identity
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The codebase already layers three such overlays onto the same sink (__configPath__ mcpManager.ts:896/1041, __additionalEnv__ mcpTypes.ts:42, __additionalHeaders__ mcpTypes.ts:41), so a maintainer adding a per-agent override for registry servers fits the existing idiom exactly.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: A second merge route where a workspace file silently replaces a global (trusted) server entry, with the trust decision then evaluated against the surviving __configPath__
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The dedupe/precedence logic is already there and is the place where the path that decides 'global vs workspace' is chosen.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: A start path that trusts a caller-supplied configPath instead of the file the config was actually read from
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: addServer/addRegistryServer both stamp __configPath__ from a parameter, and reinstallServer already has to guess the path with a fallback to the global agent path (mcpManager.ts:2037-2039).

O9_family: CWE-732 incorrect permission assignment for a critical resource - untrusted workspace configuration drives process execution without user consent
